extracted.intended_audience: U.S. patent examiners; patent applicants, attorneys, agents, and representatives of applicants
extracted.subtask_description: The Manual of Patent Examining Procedure (MPEP) is the USPTO's official reference that provides instructions, interpretations, and current procedures for the prosecution and examination of U.S. patent applications. It is maintained by the MPEP Staff in the Office of Patent Examination Policy and is intended as the authoritative guidance examiners are required or authorized to follow and practitioners should consult.

rubrics_metrics.name: Purpose and scope of the MPEP
rubrics_metrics.description: The Manual of Patent Examining Procedure (MPEP) is published to provide U.S. Patent and Trademark Office (USPTO) patent examiners, applicants, attorneys, agents, and representatives of applicants with a reference work on the practices and procedures relative to the prosecution of patent applications before the USPTO.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the MPEP as the primary USPTO reference for practices and procedures in patent prosecution; it is intended both for examiners and for practitioners to understand the standards and processes applied during examination.

rubrics_metrics.name: MPEP provides instructions, information, and interpretation
rubrics_metrics.description: It contains instructions to examiners, as well as other material in the nature of information and interpretation.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When evaluating patent applications or advising clients, rely on the MPEP for examiner instructions and for interpretive guidance about how statutes, rules, and USPTO practice are applied; treat its explanatory material as authoritative practice guidance though statutory/regulatory text is controlling.

rubrics_metrics.name: Examiners must follow current MPEP procedures in appropriate cases
rubrics_metrics.description: The MPEP outlines the current procedures which the examiners are required or authorized to follow in appropriate cases in the normal examination of a patent application.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: During examination, examiners should apply the MPEP's procedural directives where applicable; practitioners should anticipate these procedures and cite relevant MPEP provisions when interacting with examiners or filing responses.

rubrics_metrics.name: Refer to authoritative legal sources: Patent Laws and Patent Rules
rubrics_metrics.description: Resource Information and Reference Materials: Patent Laws - the latest published version of the patent laws; Patent Rules - the latest published version of the patent rules.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Always consult the current statutory and regulatory texts (patent laws and rules) as the controlling authorities; use the MPEP alongside those sources to understand application in USPTO practice.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use USPTO-provided electronic resources and guides (eMPEP, user manuals, quick reference guides)
rubrics_metrics.description: For help with search features (e.g., default operators, proximity searches, and wild cards) and navigation see: User manual, Quick Reference Guide, HTML and PDF MPEP.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When searching or navigating the MPEP and related USPTO materials, employ the official eMPEP interface and accompanying user/quick-reference guides to ensure accurate retrieval of sections and to follow navigation/search conventions; practitioners should rely on these guides for correct citation and section lookup.

rubrics_metrics.name: Supplementary USPTO resources (forms, fee schedules, official gazette, Federal Register notices) should be consulted
rubrics_metrics.description: The MPEP page lists related resources such as Fee Schedules, Forms, Official Gazette (Patents), and Federal Register Notices (Patents).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: For procedural compliance and filing requirements (fees, forms, deadlines, announced policy changes), consult the listed USPTO resources in addition to the MPEP when preparing or prosecuting patent applications.
